page_title: Esen Tunalı Sarı — Founder & Creative Director
meta_description: Discover the personal story of Esen Tunalı Sarı, the software developer and creative director harmonising artificial intelligence with bespoke jewellery design at SILVER & ELEGANT.
heading: The Creative Technologist

sections.label: My story
sections.body:
I was born in Ruse, Bulgaria — a city built along the Danube, where Brutalist architecture still stands as the dominant visual language of my earliest memories. When I was a child, my family moved to Istanbul, settling in Bakırköy. Our neighbours there were almost entirely silversmiths and jewellers, most of them working daily in the historic Kapalıçarşı district. I grew up surrounded by that craft — not as a visitor to it, but as someone who saw it practised next door, every day, as an ordinary part of life.

Years later, my family's path continued — from Turkey to the Netherlands, and finally to the United Kingdom, where I now run SILVER & ELEGANT from our studio in Borehamwood. The jewellery I carried across each of these moves was never just an ornament. It was a map of my life — the only history that travelled with us through every border.

This journey of resilience and adaptation is the heart of SILVER & ELEGANT. It is not merely a brand, but a collection of stories designed to endure.

sections.label: Design Philosophy
sections.body: Our process is a dual practice, where modern technology and traditional craftsmanship hold equal weight. I use generative design to explore complex, architectural forms — a discipline shaped by my background as a software developer — and this work is brought into the physical world through classical, artisanal production in our Istanbul atelier, the same district where I first learned to understand metal. It is in this synthesis — where digital precision meets the human hand and the language of metal — that we find the signature balance of SILVER & ELEGANT. This is not a transition from one world to the other, but a simultaneous integration of both.

We operate at the intersection of architectural minimalism and narrative jewellery. In a world of disposable consumption, SILVER & ELEGANT stands for the philosophy of 'Future Heirlooms' — objects crafted with the intent to outlast the fleeting moment of their creation, designed to be passed down through generations.
sections.label: Brand Vision

sections.body:
The brand's emergence was marked by our participation as a jewellery partner for Paul Costelloe's Autumn/Winter 2026 opening show at London Fashion Week. This milestone represents a significant step in our commitment to bringing high-concept, architectural jewellery into contemporary fashion. As a Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts (FRSA), my practice is defined by a dedication to design discipline, cultural heritage, and the continuous search for intellectual depth in aesthetic production.

Esen Tunalı Sarı, FRSA

Founder & Creative Director, SILVER & ELEGANT
